sloka: केचित्समाहता भग्नाः पतिताः समरक्षितौ ।ओष्ठांश्च दशनैस्तीक्ष्णैरदशन्कुपिता रणे ।। ७.१४.१७ ॥
transliteration: kecitsamāhatā bhagnāḥ patitāḥ samarakṣitau ।oṣṭhāṁśca daśanaistīkṣṇairadaśankupitā raṇe ।। 7.14.17 ॥

translations.english: Some, struck down and defeated, fell on the battlefield, while others, enraged in battle, bit their lips with sharp teeth.
